title: Senior Thermomechanical Analysis Engineer – Extreme Environments (all genders)
description:
Your Mission:

As Senior Thermomechanical Analysis Engineer (all genders) you will join VÆRIDION’s Technology division within the Mechanical Design & Integration team and lead the structural, stress, and thermomechanical finite element analysis (FEA) of the propulsion battery system for VÆRIDION’s CS-23 all-electric aircraft.

You will own the computational modelling of battery packs, power distribution units (PDUs), and their internal hardware, predicting how every component behaves under nominal and emergency conditions – including thermal runaway, the DO-160 environmental qualification conditions applied to the pack and PDU as airborne equipment (temperature and altitude, temperature variation, humidity, operational shocks and crash safety, and vibration), flight loads, and durability over service life. Your analysis will provide engineering evidence that the propulsion battery system is structurally robust, thermally safe, and certifiable.

Within the Mechanical Design & Integration team, you will collaborate with Mechanical Design, Materials & Processes, Test, HV Electrical Systems, Airborne Electronics, Thermal Systems, Aircraft Structures, Certification, Safety, and Quality teams to define analysis methods, apply the material property allowable required for your analyses, and substantiate the qualification of the propulsion battery pack and PDU. You will be the structural and thermomechanical analysis authority for the propulsion battery system, responsible for checking and releasing design against the applicable stress and thermomechanical requirements.

Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION’s mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead the structural, stress, and thermomechanical FEA of propulsion battery packs, PDUs, and their internal components, predicting how they behave under nominal operation and emergency conditions – including thermal runaway, the DO-160 environmental qualification conditions, and flight and inertial loads.

  • Perform room-temperature and elevated-temperature analysis of composites (including sandwich structures), metals, adhesives, and mechanical fasteners, capturing temperature-dependent material behaviour.

  • Build and correlate nonlinear models covering material, geometric, and contact nonlinearity – including cohesive-zone and VCCT delamination, composite progressive failure and damage propagation, metal plasticity and rate-dependent behaviour, crushable foam plasticity and densification, large-deformation and post-buckling response, and frictional contact with bolt pretension, including bearing behaviour at fastener holes (bearing yield, hole elongation, and bearing–bypass interaction).

  • Model the hyper-elastic and viscoelastic behaviour of potting compounds, gap fillers, foams, gaskets, seals, and thermal interface materials to predict contact pressure and interface integrity across the life of the pack.

  • Perform durability and life analysis across the differing service lives of components within the system, covering vibration-induced high-cycle fatigue (DO-160 random and sine sweep), low-cycle fatigue from ground–air–ground and charge/discharge thermal cycling, and fatigue of bonded joints, fasteners, busbars, and interconnects.

  • Assess creep and stress relaxation of seals, adhesives, polymers, potting compounds, and thermal interface materials at elevated temperature, including loss of contact pressure across a pack replacement interval.

  • Analyse thermal runaway response as a coupled thermomechanical event – pressure loads, direct impingement flow, ejecta, and heat transfer to surrounding structure and systems – working closely with the Thermal Systems team on thermal runaway CFD modelling and the resulting heat transfer boundary conditions, in support of containment and continued safe flight and landing.

  • Apply static, fatigue, and creep material property allowable (room and elevated temperature) in the substantiation of the propulsion battery pack and PDU, working to established methodologies such as CMH-17 for composites and MMPDS for metallics, and specify the allowable, material data, and test conditions required from the Materials & Processes and Test teams.

title: Sales Manager für Kola NetZero (m/w/d)
description:
Über Kola NetZero

Kola NetZero (kola-netzero.de) ist ein Venture der Kola Invest GmbH, einem inhabergeführten Family Office aus Hamburg. Wir machen die energetische Modernisierung von Mehrfamilienhäusern für professionelle Eigentümer erreichbar: Alte Öl- oder Gasheizungen werden ohne eigene Investition des Eigentümers auf ein modernes Wärmepumpensystem umgestellt. Der Eigentümer kauft nur noch Wärme zu einem festen Preis. Planung, Umbau, Betrieb und Wartung übernimmt unser Anbieter, der dieses Modell bereits bei über 55.000 Wohneinheiten umgesetzt hat.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen Sales Manager (m/w/d) in Vollzeit am Standort Hamburg, der Eigentümer von Mehrfamilienhäusern von unserem Angebot überzeugt und Objekte bis zum Vertragsabschluss begleitet.

Aufgaben

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Aktive Ansprache und Gewinnung von Eigentümern von Mehrfamilienhäusern (ab 6 Wohneinheiten) sowie von Hausverwaltungen und Maklern als Empfehlungspartner.

  • Qualifizierung eingehender Leads und Anfragen über kola-netzero.de.

  • Präsentation unseres Wärmelieferungsmodells vor Ort und digital, inklusive Erläuterung der wirtschaftlichen Vorteile.

  • Einreichung und Vorprüfung geeigneter Objekte (Heizkostenabrechnung, Energieausweis) über unsere Plattform.

  • Begleitung des Eigentümers vom Erstgespräch über das Angebot bis zur Vertragsunterschrift.

  • Aufbau und Betreuung eines Netzwerks freier Vertriebspartner.

  • Pflege unseres CRM sowie Reporting zu Pipeline und Abschlüssen.

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung bei der Weiterentwicklung von Vertriebsstrategie und Vertriebsmaterialien.

Qualifikation

Ihr Profil

  • Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, idealerweise im Bereich Immobilien, Energie, Heizungstechnik oder erklärungsbedürftiger Produkte.

  • Nachweisbare Abschlusserfolge und Freude an der Neukundengewinnung.

  • Verständnis für die Perspektive von Immobilieneigentümern (Wirtschaftlichkeit, Energieklassen, Sanierungsdruck) oder die Bereitschaft, sich schnell einzuarbeiten.

  • Unternehmerisches Denken sowie eine selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise.

  • Ausgeprägtes Verhandlungsgeschick und souveränes Auftreten.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

  • Führerschein der Klasse B sowie Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands.

Benefits

Das bieten wir

  • Eine Vollzeitstelle in Hamburg mit unbefristetem Arbeitsvertrag.

  • Attraktives Vergütungsmodell aus Fixgehalt und leistungsorientierter Provision.

  • Ein Produkt mit echtem Mehrwert für Eigentümer: keine eigene Investition, bis zu 5 Energieklassen besser, höherer Immobilienwert.

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und viel Gestaltungsspielraum.

  • Langfristige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einer wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe.

  • Ein motiviertes Team mit unternehmerischer Denkweise und hoher Eigenverantwortung.

Interesse?

title: Senior Product Manager - Productization (m/w/d)
description:

Wir haben in den letzten Jahren gezeigt, dass wir echte Kundenprobleme lösen können. Jetzt geht es darum, aus bewährten Lösungen wiederholbare Produkte zu machen, die sich skalierbar verkaufen und liefern lassen. Genau dafür suchen wir Dich!

Du machst aus validierten Kundenlösungen skalierbare Produkte. Unser Product-Modell folgt drei Phasen: 0→1 (Kundenproblem verstehen, Lösung im Kundenfall beweisen), 1→n (daraus ein wiederholbares Produkt machen) und n (skalierbar verkaufen, liefern, weiterentwickeln).

Dein Fokus liegt auf 1→ n1→n: Du klärst, was das Produkt ist, für wen, welchen messbaren Mehrwert es liefert und wie es als Standardangebot verkauft und geliefert wird. Du verantwortest Produkt und Produktisierung – Engineering, Delivery, Sales und Product Marketing bleiben für Umsetzung, Kundenprojekt, Opportunity und Vermarktung zuständig. Darüber hinaus verantwortest Du den Lifecycle bestehender Produkte: Du sicherst ihre Stärken und Standards und entwickelst sie gezielt weiter.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Validierte Lösungen konsequent in wiederholbare, standardisierte Angebote überführen

  • Zielkunden, Pain, Business Value und Value Proposition schärfen

  • Klaren Standardumfang und klare Produktgrenzen definieren – inklusive dessen, was bewusst nicht dazugehört

  • Gemeinsam mit Engineering die notwendige Produktreife herstellen

  • Kundenfeedback pragmatisch in Produktentscheidungen übersetzen

  • Product Marketing die fachliche Grundlage für Positionierung, Messaging und Content geben

  • Sales und Presales befähigen, das Produkt ohne permanente Product-Unterstützung zu erklären und zu verkaufen

  • Delivery befähigen, Einführung und Betrieb mit kalkulierbarem Aufwand umzusetzen

  • Lifecycle, Weiterentwicklung und Priorisierung verantworten, für neu produktisierte ebenso wie für bestehende Produkte, deren Stärken und Standards es zu sichern gilt

Was Du mitbringst

  • 5+ Jahre relevante Erfahrung im Product Management im komplexen B2B- bzw. Enterprise-Software-Umfeld

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung darin, aus individuellen Kundenanforderungen, Piloten oder Prototypen ein standardisiertes, wiederholbares Produkt zu machen

  • Sehr gutes technisches Verständnis für komplexe Software-, Daten- und AI-Produkte: Du arbeitest mit Engineering auf Augenhöhe und verbindest Business, Kunde, Produkt und Technologie – ohne selbst Engineer sein zu müssen

  • Reisebereitschaft für Kundentermine vor Ort

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift

Was die Rolle nicht ist

Damit Du einschätzen kannst, ob die Rolle zu Dir passt: Wir suchen bewusst nicht

  • einen klassischen Product Owner mit Schwerpunkt Backlog und Tickets,

  • einen reinen Projektmanager,

  • einen weiteren 0→1-Innovator,

  • Kurze Wege: direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführung, Engineering, Sales und Delivery

title: Head of Growth
description:
The role

The Head of Growth owns every paid route to a new TALA customer. You will set the acquisition strategy, own the media budget and be measured on the new customers it brings in. The role leads the Growth pillar of the Digital & Customer team, and is central to taking TALA from c. £30m to £100m+ in revenue.

You will lead a small in-house team and our agency partners, work closely with brand, creative and the Customer and Digital Experience teams, and grow TALA into new channels and new markets.

What you will be accountable for

You will be responsible for new customer growth and the efficiency of every pound spent to acquire it.

  • Deliver new customer volume, CAC and first-order contribution targets across all paid channels

  • Own the acquisition budget and its allocation across channels, markets and campaigns against CAC, ROAS, blended MER and payback

  • Build the annual and in-season acquisition plan with finance, including new customer targets, media budgets and forecasts

  • Grow the share of high-value new customers, working with your peers in the customer team on cohort and lifetime value data

  • Report weekly and monthly on acquisition performance, trade-offs and recommendations to the Digital & Customer Director and leadership team

Paid media and channels

  • Own paid social across Meta, TikTok, Pinterest and Snapchat, including prospecting, retargeting and creator partnership ads

  • Own paid search and shopping, including brand, non-brand and Performance Max

  • Own video and programmatic, using upper-funnel media to build reach and demand alongside direct response

  • Own affiliates and partnerships, including publisher, content and strategic brand partners

  • Run a structured test, learn and scale approach to new channels, such as TikTok Shop

  • Build TALA's visibility in AI search and shopping, including ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Mode, working with the Head of Digital Experience

  • Manage the trading calendar for paid media around launches, drops, collaborations and key promotional moments, with merchandising and brand

Measurement and insight

  • Own the acquisition measurement framework, combining platform data, attribution, incrementality testing and media mix modelling

  • Run an ongoing programme of incrementality tests, including geo-lift and holdout studies, and use the results to set budgets

  • Measure the effect of paid media on store sales as well as online, as TALA becomes more omnichannel

  • Work with the Head of Digital Experience on tracking, attribution and server-side data, so the numbers are trusted across the business

  • Partner with finance and the data team on a single view of CAC, MER and payback

Creative and brand

  • Partner with the brand and creative teams on performance creative, setting briefs from channel and audience insight

  • Build a high-volume creative testing programme across formats, hooks and talent, and feed the results back into brand and product

  • Use AI tools to increase the volume and speed of creative production and testing, keeping all work on brand

  • Work closely with the Brand Marketing Director on PR, influencer, creator and community activity, and put paid spend behind what works

  • Protect the TALA brand in every paid placement, balancing short-term returns with long-term brand building

New markets and growth

  • Lead paid acquisition for international market launches, from test budgets and localisation to scaling in each market

  • Support store openings, including Edinburgh, with local awareness and footfall campaigns

  • Work with the Customer team on referral, reactivation and lapsed-customer acquisition

  • Partner with the Head of Digital Experience on landing pages, conversion and SEO, so paid traffic converts

Team and agency leadership

  • Lead, coach and develop a small team of acquisition specialists

  • Decide the right mix of in-house capability and agency partners, and manage agency relationships, briefs, fees and performance

  • Manage the growth technology stack, including attribution, analytics, affiliate and creative tools, with clear return on each

  • Lead the use of AI across the growth function, building it into media buying, budget allocation, creative, analysis and reporting

  • Build the team's AI skills, with the right tools, training and clear guidelines on brand, data and privacy

  • Build a culture of experimentation, pace and ownership of results

  • Stay hands-on in the platforms and the numbers

About you

You are a commercial growth marketer who has scaled paid acquisition for a fast-growing consumer brand. You are as comfortable in a contribution model as you are in Ads Manager, and you’re equally passionate about our brand and product as you are about working in one of the fastest-paced disciplines in marketing.

Experience

  • 8-10+ years in performance or growth marketing, with at least 3 years leading a team, ideally in high-growth DTC fashion, activewear or beauty

  • A proven record of scaling new customer acquisition profitably, ideally in a business growing from £20m+ towards £100m+

  • Ownership of a multi-million pound annual media budget across several channels

  • Deep, hands-on expertise in paid social and paid search, and experience across video, programmatic and affiliates

  • Experience with incrementality testing, media mix modelling and multi-touch attribution, and using them to make budget decisions

  • Experience launching paid media in new international markets

  • A strong understanding of performance creative and creator-led advertising

  • Experience selecting and managing agency partners and growth technology

  • A track record of using AI to improve marketing performance and efficiency, including AI-led buying such as Meta Advantage+ and Performance Max, creative production and analysis

  • Experience leading a team through AI adoption, with measurable gains in output, speed or cost

  • Strong working knowledge of Shopify, GA4 and attribution tools

Competencies

  • Commercially sharp: thinks in CAC, payback and contribution, and makes budget calls on marginal return

  • Analytical: highly numerate, tests and measures everything, and questions the data

  • Customer-focused: understands who the customer is, what they respond to and what they are worth

  • Brand-minded: builds the TALA brand through paid media as well as driving sales

About the team

We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way.

As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translates

If you want to be the person leadership turns to for an honest read of the business, and to see your analysis change real product and commercial decisions, this role is for you. 

What you'll do 

Shape commercial decisions 

  • Own the SumUp Consumer KPI framework end to end — defining which metrics matter, how they're measured and how they connect customer behaviour to commercial outcomes. 
  • Evaluate the quality of our growth: CAC, source attribution, channel performance and downstream customer value, separating headline growth from sustainable growth. 
  • Work with Risk and Anti-Fraud so fraud, abuse and economic loss are built into how we judge customers, channels and markets. 

Drive product decisions 

  • Diagnose where customers drop out between acquisition and activation, and which behaviours drive repeat usage, retention and lifetime value. 
  • Design and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, assessing both customer and commercial impact. 
  • Help Product Managers size opportunities and judge whether shipped features delivered the outcomes they promised. 

Influence with data 

  • Act as an independent analytical partner to Consumer leadership and to Product, Growth, Finance and Risk — proactively surfacing trends, risks and opportunities rather than waiting for requests. Challenge assumptions, metric definitions and interpretations constructively when the evidence points elsewhere. 
  • Build trusted reporting and help teams self-serve routine questions, so your time goes on the problems that matter most. 
  • Use AI and LLM-assisted techniques to speed up analysis, customer understanding and insight generation. 

You'll be great for this role if… 

  • You form your own view of why something happened and what the business should do about it — not just report what happened. 
  • You've influenced senior stakeholders with data, including changing a decision or overturning a long-held assumption.

description:
Ingénieur R&D Conception d'équipements d’essais  (H/F)

À propos de notre client

Notre client est une TPE basée au nord de Lyon, spécialisée dans les énergies du sous-sol : pétrole, gaz, géothermie et stockage de CO2. Son activité repose entièrement sur la R&D : essais sur géomatériaux, géomécanique et développement d'équipements d'essais pour des clients internationaux.

Son équipe pluridisciplinaire et multiculturelle développe des solutions technologiques innovantes au service de l'efficacité, de la protection de l'environnement et de la maîtrise des coûts. L'entreprise est certifiée ISO 9001 et toutes ses activités respectent sa démarche QHSE.

Le poste

Pour accélérer ses projets de développement, notre client recrute un(e) Ingénieur(e) R&D en conception d'équipements d'essais.  Vous prendrez en charge la conception, la mise au point et la validation de cellules d'essais haute température et haute pression, un sujet stratégique pour l'entreprise et ses clients.

Rattaché(e) à la direction des opérations, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe qui conçoit aujourd'hui les équipements et dépose les brevets de l'entreprise.

Répartition indicative du temps : environ 70 à 80 % conception et développement, 20 à 30 % laboratoire (montage et validation de vos équipements).

Dans une structure à taille humaine, vous suivrez vos développements de la conception jusqu'aux tests, avant leur transfert à l'équipe de production.

Vos missions

Conception et développement d'équipements d’essais

  • Concevoir de nouvelles cellules et de nouveaux dispositifs d'essais, notamment pour des conditions de haute température et de haute pression.
  • Résoudre les problématiques techniques associées : instrumentation et capteurs, étanchéité, tenue en température et en pression.
  • Consulter les fournisseurs et sous-traitants, et suivre la fabrication des pièces.
  • Améliorer les équipements existants, notamment leur ergonomie et leur facilité d'utilisation en production.

Mise au point et validation

  • Monter les équipements développés et réaliser leurs tests de validation au laboratoire.
  • Interpréter les résultats expérimentaux et vérifier leur cohérence.
  • Transférer les équipements validés à l'équipe de production et l'accompagner dans leur prise en main.

Documentation et propriété intellectuelle

  • Rédiger la documentation technique, les rapports et les comptes-rendus, et les présenter, en français comme en anglais.
  • Participer à la veille technique et à la rédaction des documents de protection (brevets, enveloppes Soleau).

Vie du laboratoire

  • Comprendre les essais réalisés au laboratoire pour concevoir des équipements adaptés à leurs besoins.
  • Contribuer à l'activité du labo et à l'amélioration continue, dans le respect de la démarche qualité ISO 9001.

Requirements

Compétences techniques

  • Conception mécanique et maîtrise d'un logiciel de CAO.
  • Instrumentation, capteurs et techniques de mesure.
  • Compréhension des grandeurs physiques et physico-chimiques.
  • Rédaction technique et anglais professionnel, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.

Savoir-être

  • Autonomie et capacité à prendre en main un sujet de bout en bout.
  • Rigueur, notamment dans les phases d'essais.
  • Polyvalence et goût du concret : vous aimez concevoir autant que tester vous-même vos équipements.
  • Communication proactive, en particulier pour remonter et résoudre les difficultés rencontrées.
  • Envie d'apprendre et de s'investir dans une petite structure.

Formation et expérience

  • Diplôme d'ingénieur ou équivalent Bac +5 en génie mécanique, conception, instrumentation ou mesures physiques.
  • Expérience d'environ 5 ans en conception d'équipements, en bureau d'études ou en R&D. Les profils plus juniors avec une première expérience significative en conception seront étudiés.
  • Une expérience sur des équipements soumis à des contraintes de température ou de pression est un vrai plus.

Benefits

Vous rejoindrez une entreprise à taille humaine où chaque développement compte : vos équipements seront directement utilisés pour des projets de R&D menés pour des clients internationaux. Vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe dynamique et multiculturelle, sur des sujets techniques exigeants au service des énergies du sous-sol et de la transition énergétique.

We are seeking a detail-oriented Mechanical Design Engineer to join our engineering team in Lausanne. What We Are Looking For

  • Background: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.

  • CAD & Drafting Experience: Strong proficiency in production CAD environments with experience applying formal drafting standards such as ASME or ISO GD&T.

  • Product Data Management: Practical experience with configuration management practices, engineering change notices, and product data systems such as Siemens Teamcenter or similar PDM/PLM tools.

  • Manufacturing Tooling & Processes: Design experience across multiple manufacturing methods including machining, stamping, casting, forging, and molding.

  • Analysis & Verification: Ability to perform basic environmental, thermal, shock, and stress evaluations to qualify hardware designs against operational requirements.

  • Proactive Execution: Practical mindset with strong hands-on skills for prototype assembly, vendor management, and technical troubleshooting.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to establish core mechanical design capability and elevate drafting standards within a growing engineering team.

  • Direct hands-on work spanning initial CAD concepts through to manufacturing and field testing.

  • Broad exposure to complex electromechanical hardware, structural housings, and safety-critical mechanisms.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

The Role

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Mechanical Engineer to join our engineering team in Lausanne. You will handle the end-to-end design, numerical simulation, and physical validation of specialised mechanical and electromechanical structures to optimize system performance and match hardware capabilities to demanding operational requirements.

From day one, you will take ownership of mechanical architectures and physical assemblies. You will run non-linear explicit finite element simulations, build high-precision CAD models, set up lab and range tests, and see designs through to production and final delivery.

What You Will Do

  • Structural & Dynamics Simulation: Run non-linear explicit finite element simulations to build predictive models for structural integrity, dynamic impact, vibration response, and high-velocity mechanical behavior against extreme physical operational environments.

  • CAD Design & Drafting: Create and maintain complex CAD models, structural housings, mechanisms, and technical drawings for production release.

  • Empirical Testing & Data Capture: Write R&D test specifications for environmental, drop, structural, and shock testing. Source specialized testing equipment, manage range and lab setups, and analyze sensor data to validate simulation accuracy.

  • Cross-Functional Integration: Work directly with multidisciplinary engineering teams to advise on physical constraints, payload optimization, spatial layouts, and mechanical integration parameters.

  • Safety & Hazard Assessments: Conduct system-level hazard analyses and safety evaluations for critical mechanical mechanisms and energetic system interfaces.

  • Production & Field Support: Document hardware performance guidelines, assist with first-production validation, optimize designs for manufacturing processes, and provide technical support during end-user demos and customer engagements.

What We Are Looking For

  • Background: B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Applied Physics, or a related technical discipline.

We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

 

How it works

 

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering

title: (Senior) Programmatic Sales GSA
description:
YOUR FUTURE, ON DEMAND

The ideal blend of stability and flexibility. A genuinely human employer that cares for people and the planet. True autonomy to shape what comes next, for us and you. This is the perfect platform to take your career where you want.

Back in 2005, we pioneered Europe’s first TV streaming service. Today, we're a leading TV streaming provider with millions of monthly users, and since 2021 we've been ClimatePartner-certified. Over 200 colleagues of 47 nationalities. We’re the grown-up start-up, helping to shape a better future since day one.That hasn’t changed, even if the world has. We’re friendly, international, inclusive – and our people say we’re reliable and transparent, too. It’s why they trust us and believe in what we do.

THE ROLE

As a Programmatic Sales GSA, you will be responsible for the automated and data-driven sale of our digital advertising inventory (primarily video and CTV) and report directly to the Director Sales All Markets. You will manage programmatic bookings, oversee the planning, implementation and optimisation of our initiatives to boost revenue in programmatic sales, and will therefore also be directly responsible for the optimisation and smooth, technical implementation of campaigns. This makes you the primary point of contact for agency trading desks in the GSA region regarding preferred deals and PMP strategies. You’ll also help with SSP and header bidding integrations and act as the link between Sales, Tech and AdOps.

THE ADS TEAM

The Ads Team is a small but highly efficient team that combines technology and marketing to win customers over in the long term. With a presence in two countries (based in Berlin, Hamburg and Zurich) and operations in six countries, the Ads Team is a key driver of growth within Zattoo and has established itself as the market leader in CTV in Switzerland within a year.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Acquisition of new customers, advice, support and guide media agencies, trading desks and direct clients through our programmatic possibilities in a way they can understand.
  • Drawing up and negotiating bespoke programme packages, private deals or preferred deals.
  • Maximise inventory revenue, skilfully manage floor prices (minimum prices) and analyse delivery rates and CPMs.
  • Partner with regional sales teams in GSA to consult clients and pitch programmatic solutions.
  • Co-lead the technical and commercial setup of Header Bidding and additional SSP integrations for CTV.
  • First-line technical ownership of programmatic delivery.
  • Identify technical errors during delivery, analyse tracking issues and check campaign set-ups: troubleshoot deal delivery, floor pricing, and DSP configuration issues (e.g., SSAI, VAST responses, pod management, DSP/SSP bid stream mismatches).
  • Explain complex technical matters in simple terms to non-technical customers or internal departments.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • 4+ years of experience in Programmatic Advertising, SSP Management, or Programmatic Account Management (strong experience in CTV/Video)
  • A proven track record in the sales of digital advertising products
  • Deep understanding of Google Ad Manager, DSP/SSP workflows, OpenRTB specs, and deal types (Preferred Deals, PMP, PG)
  • Experience or strong technical familiarity with Header Bidding frameworks (e.g., Prebid) and SSP integrations
  • Strong network or understanding of the DACH Agency Trading Desk landscape
  • Fluent in German and English
  • Independent, strong communicator, able to work under pressure, with strong negotiation skills
  • Teamplayer and creative thinker with a questioning mindset.

WHY JOIN US?

At Zattoo, you’re always on firm ground with real freedom to explore. You’ll have the support and opportunity you need to go far, while you’re helping us create a sustainable and entertainment-filled future for all.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

  • Reward: strong market competitive salary
  • Recharge: 30 days vacation plus public holidays
  • Regulate: trust based flexible working hours and the option for remote work worldwide for up to 8 weeks per year

Plus:

  • We’re sharing: Free access to the best streaming experience on the market
  • We're developing: Your own development budget, German classes and Zattoo all-company hack days
  • We’re inclusive: ‘Zattooies’ are a fun, engaged, and diverse team made up of 47 nationalities
  • We’re healthy: Health checks, mental wellbeing support, team sports and more!
  • We’re responsible: We are carbon neutral, an active employee Green team, discounted BVG tickets and free bike rentals
  • We’re sociable: A calendar of events with fireside chats, lunches, in-house bar, BBQ’s, monthly socials, summer party and an annual off-site event

Zattoo enables our users to view indiscriminately and we reflect that in our team too. Regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability or any other characteristic protected by law we encourage everyone to apply and will give everyone equal consideration. We are an equal opportunities employer — join us and help build a diverse team dedicated to revolutionising the way you watch TV.

We are committed to ensuring fair, open, and equitable hiring practices and are happy to answer any questions you may have about us or the role throughout the whole process. In line with the EU Pay Transparency Directive, we share the applicable compensation range with you before your first interview.

If you bring taste, pace and a real feel for the mobile and tech scene, let's talk.

In this role you will:

  • Industry Events & Conferences: Plan and deliver exmox's presence at the conferences that matter in mobile gaming and adtech, from booths and speaking slots to side events and partner dinners, and help decide where we show up and where we skip.

description:
Deine Rolle

Wir sind HeyHoney, ein wachsendes Unternehmen mit einer treuen Community und einem klaren Produkt. Diese Community ist eines unserer wertvollsten Assets – und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Dein Verantwortungsbereich

Content & Social Media: Du betreust und entwickelst unsere organischen Kanäle – insbesondere Instagram, TikTok und Pinterest – und hast Trends, Plattform-Logiken und neue Formate immer im Blick.

Content-Produktion: Du entwickelst Content-Ideen und setzt sie hands-on um – insbesondere Short-Form-Video. Dabei kannst du sowohl neuen Content produzieren als auch vorhandenes Material kreativ weiterdenken und daraus neue, plattformgerechte Inhalte entwickeln. Für Produktionen arbeitest du bei Bedarf mit UGC-Creator und Freelancer zusammen und steuerst diese eigenständig.

Community Management: Du bist eine der Stimmen von HeyHoney. Du interagierst regelmäßig mit unserer Community, aktivierst sie und entwickelst Ideen, mit denen aus Kund echte Fans werden. Dabei entwickelst du Community-Formate, die Bindung und Retention stärken.

Community Events: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team Ideen für Community Events und begleitest deren Umsetzung – von Planung und Partner-/Location-Auswahl bis zur Durchführung und Nachbereitung.

Launch-Support: Für unsere Kollektions-Launches entwickelst du organische Content- und Community-Ideen und verzahnst sie eng mit unseren Paid-Aktivitäten.

Analytics & Reporting: Du behältst relevante KPIs wie Reichweite, Engagement und Community-Wachstum im Blick, erkennst, welche Inhalte funktionieren, und leitest daraus konkrete Learnings und neue Content-Ideen ab.

Was du mitbringst

Du fühlst dich auf Social Media zu Hause und verstehst, warum Content funktioniert – oder eben nicht. Dabei ist uns dein Gespür für Content, Community und relevante KPIs wichtiger als eine bestimmte Anzahl an Berufsjahren.

Idealerweise bringst du mindestens ein Jahr praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Social Media, Content oder Community mit – zum Beispiel aus einer Festanstellung, Werkstudentätigkeit, einem Praktikum, Freelance-Projekten oder eigenen Social-Media-Projekten.

Du bist hands-on: Du kannst Content von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung begleiten und hast ein gutes Auge für Ästhetik, Trends und die unterschiedlichen Logiken von Instagram, TikTok & Co.

Du verstehst Content Creation: Du kannst selbst drehen und schneiden und weißt gleichzeitig, wann Creator, UGC oder Freelancer die bessere Lösung sind. Du musst dabei nicht zwingend selbst vor der Kamera stehen – wichtiger ist, dass du gute Inhalte erkennst, entwickeln und umsetzen kannst.

Du kannst Community: Du verstehst, wie aus Reichweite Interaktion und aus Interaktion echte Bindung entsteht. Wenn du bereits eine Community oder eigene Social-Media-Kanäle aufgebaut hast, umso besser.

Du schreibst markensicher: Du hast ein gutes Sprachgefühl und triffst den Ton einer modernen Lifestyle-Brand.

Du denkst in Zahlen: Reichweite, Engagement Rate, Watch Time oder Community-Wachstum sind für dich nicht nur Reporting-Zahlen. Du nutzt sie, um zu verstehen, was funktioniert und was wir beim nächsten Mal besser machen können.

Du setzt um: Du wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jeder einzelne Schritt vorgegeben wird. Du bringst Ideen ein, probierst Dinge aus, lernst daraus und treibst deine Themen eigenständig voran.

Uns ist dabei nicht wichtig, dass du schon jede dieser Aufgaben perfekt beherrschst. Wenn du Social Media verstehst, Lust hast, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, schnell lernst und HeyHoney gemeinsam mit uns weiterentwickeln möchtest, wollen wir dich kennenlernen.

Content, Community und Events sind bei uns bewusst noch nicht auserzählt. Das bedeutet: Du kommst nicht in ein fertiges System, sondern kannst aktiv mitgestalten.

Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Die Rolle kann mit dir wachsen. Wenn du Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest und zeigst, dass deine Ideen funktionieren, bekommst du bei uns den Raum dafür.

Miteinander, das zur Marke passt: Wir sind ein herzliches, offenes Team und leben den HeyHoney-Spirit auch intern – mit Augenhöhe, Vertrauen und einem wertschätzenden Miteinander, das auch über die Distanz trägt.

title: Senior Consumer Duty Specialist
description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

In this role, you will play a central part in assessing, questioning, and enhancing how customers experience Pleo. Drawing on deep regulatory knowledge, you will lead Consumer Duty initiatives, actively spot potential customer harm, examine what drives customer journeys, and ensure targeted remediation creates lasting, positive impact.

You'll need sharp analytical skills and the confidence to influence stakeholders, translating data and MI into decisive action. You will construct and manage dashboards and reporting mechanisms that illuminate emerging patterns, vulnerable customer risks, and key concerns, offering executive leadership clear visibility into operational gaps and necessary solutions.

Your contribution goes well beyond producing MI. You will conduct QA across complex complaint handling and sensitive customer interactions, manage Ombudsman cases, and speak up when evidence shows outcomes aren't meeting expectations. Collaborating across teams, you'll turn data-driven insights into practical improvements, drive projects to completion, and evaluate whether changes deliver real results for our users.

We're seeking someone who views Consumer Duty as a powerful driver of business improvement rather than a routine compliance exercise. You'll bring together technical understanding, rigorous analysis, and constructive challenge to investigate root causes, align key partners, deliver change, and prove that customer experiences are continuously getting better.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You'll work closely with teams across Customer Support, Complaints, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Product, Data, Technology, and other business functions.

The role will have broad exposure across the organisation, particularly when customer outcome risks or Consumer Duty-related remediation require cross-functional action.

You'll also work closely with senior stakeholders through Consumer Duty governance and reporting, helping translate detailed analysis into clear insights, risks, recommendations, and actions.

What you’ll be doing

As a Consumer Duty Specialist, you will:

  • Turn data into customer outcome insight: Build and own MI, dashboards, KPIs, and reporting that give the business a clear view of customer outcomes, trends, risks, and emerging areas of concern.

  • Own Consumer Duty reporting: Produce monthly and quarterly Consumer Duty reporting, turning complex data into a clear story for senior leadership and Board-level audiences. You'll go beyond showing what happened to explain why it matters and what we should do about it.

  • Identify customer harm: Use complaints, QA findings, customer feedback, vulnerable customer data, Ombudsman cases, and MI to identify potential customer harm, emerging risks, and systemic issues.

  • Challenge the business: Where the evidence suggests customers aren't receiving good outcomes, you'll be expected to ask difficult questions, challenge assumptions, and ensure the issue is properly understood and addressed.

  • Drive remediation and change: Work with stakeholders across the business to agree remediation plans, establish clear owners and timelines, and help drive Consumer Duty-related projects and improvements through to completion.

  • Provide complaints QA: Conduct weekly quality reviews of complaints handled by the Complaints Manager, using findings to identify quality issues, customer risks, and wider trends.

  • Manage Ombudsman activity: Act as the primary operational contact with the UK Ombudsman, managing referred complaints, responses, remedies, compensation, invoices, and related communications.

  • Leverage AI and smart automation: Spot opportunities to apply automated tools and AI to scale and streamline Consumer Duty analytics, monitoring, and workflows. You will feel empowered to test emerging tech and eliminate repetitive manual work, maintaining proper critical evaluation and human governance whenever compliance risks or customer impacts are involved.

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • Strong Consumer Duty knowledge: You understand the principles of Consumer Duty and how they translate into practical customer outcomes, particularly across complaints, customer support, vulnerable customers, and customer journeys.

  • Strong data and MI experience: You know how to take complex data, build meaningful dashboards and reporting, and identify the insights that actually matter. You're comfortable working with data rather than simply consuming reports created by others.

  • A customer outcome mindset: You're naturally curious about how customers are experiencing the business and are able to connect data, customer feedback, complaints, and operational activity to real customer outcomes.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills: You can spot trends, anomalies, and patterns, investigate root causes, and determine whether an issue is isolated or potentially systemic.

  • The confidence to challenge: You're comfortable questioning decisions, processes, and assumptions when the evidence suggests customers may be experiencing poor outcomes. You can challenge constructively and build relationships at the same time.

  • A bias towards action: You don't believe reporting is the end of the process. You want to understand what needs to change, bring people together, and help make it happen.

  • Project and remediation experience: You're comfortable managing actions, timelines, dependencies, stakeholders, and risks across cross-functional projects, particularly where there is a regulatory, customer, or operational outcome to deliver.

  • An AI and automation mindset: You're naturally curious about how AI and automation can make processes more efficient, improve analysis, and free up time for higher-value work. You look for sensible opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and use AI to augment your thinking, while maintaining appropriate human oversight, critical judgement, and accountability — particularly where customer outcomes or regulatory decisions are involved.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You love using data to uncover things that others might not see.

  • You want your analysis to drive real change, rather than sit in a report or dashboard.

  • You enjoy asking "why?" and getting to the root cause of customer problems.

  • You're comfortable challenging the business when the evidence tells you something isn't working.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer to produce reporting without being involved in what happens afterwards.

  • You're uncomfortable challenging stakeholders or having difficult conversations when customer outcomes aren't where they should be.

  • You prefer working within a narrow functional remit rather than across multiple teams.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:

  • Build a deep understanding of our customer outcome data, existing Consumer Duty MI, complaints, vulnerable customer journeys, and current areas of risk.

  • Take ownership of key Consumer Duty dashboards and reporting, developing a clear view of the metrics and insights that matter most.

  • Establish strong relationships with stakeholders across Customer Support, Complaints, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Product, Data, and Technology.

  • Lead the analysis behind Consumer Duty reporting and help shape how customer outcomes are presented to senior stakeholders and the Board.

Over time, you'll have the opportunity to shape how Pleo measures, understands, and improves customer outcomes, helping move Consumer Duty from a regulatory obligation into a genuine driver of better customer experiences and better business decisions.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Meet the Hiring Manager: 1hr going through role in more depth.

  3. Pleo Challenge: A case study were you talk us through how you'd solve a work appropriate challenge.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we advertised this role, we received a really high volume of applications but could only select so many. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

description:

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

About the Role


The way legal work gets done is changing, and Engagement is at the centre of that transformation. We're looking for an experienced Engagement Manager to own Legora's global relationship with one of the Big 4, one of our most significant partnerships, and to fundamentally change the way that firm works with Legora.

This is a role for someone who has led change inside large, complex organisations and knows that real transformation is designed and managed. You will own the adoption and long-term success of this client globally: building the relationships, defining the outcomes and serving as the trusted adviser and orchestrator who turns Legora into an embedded part of how their teams operate.

Global means global. You will set the strategy for how the firm adopts Legora worldwide, and Engagement Managers in other regions will run their local programmes against the direction and decisions you set. Day to day, you will be the point of contact for the firm's UK and Ireland practice from our London office, and you will travel regularly to other
member firms in the network to build those relationships and land the programme on the ground. Expect to be travelling around 25% of the time.

You will build the roadmap, sequence initiatives from initial rollout through firm-wide scaled adoption, define measurable outcomes and ROI and evolve the programme as new AI capabilities and use cases emerge.

You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class adoption programme at Legora, helping the client realise measurable ROI, expand successful use cases and transform the way their teams work.

What You'll Do


You'll own the global relationship end to end, leading the post-sale experience across every member firm we work with. Specifically, you will:


● Set the global adoption strategy for the account and lead its execution across regions. Engagement Managers in other markets will deliver their local programmes against the strategy and decisions you set, and you will be accountable for coherence and outcomes globally.
● Act as the primary point of contact for the firm's UK and Ireland practice, while travelling frequently to other member firms to build senior relationships and support local delivery in person.
● Design the client's adoption playbook: the tailored change-management approach, stakeholder map and target outcomes for how the firm adopts Legora and transforms the way it works.

● Drive sustained value through a structured operating cadence: success plans, enablement, stakeholder check-ins, training and value reviews.
● Orchestrate engagement from cross-functional teams to accelerate client success (GTM, Product, Legal Engineering, Engineering, Marketing, Support), maintaining end-to-end account context and coordination globally.
● Partner with GTM on key commercial moments to ensure seamless transitions, continuity and exceptional customer experience, and to identify and realise expansion opportunities across the account.
● Translate customer feedback into action by collaborating closely with Product, Engineering and Marketing to inform roadmap, positioning and enablement.


What You Bring


You care deeply about customer outcomes and you know that transformation has to be designed and led. You're proactive, strategic and comfortable steering demanding, senior stakeholders through significant change. You take pride in being the reason customers adopt, grow and succeed.

We're looking for:


● 5+ years experience in management consulting, legal, LegalTech or customer success in an AI-native B2B vertical.
● Extensive experience working with or inside a Big 4 firm is highly desirable, we want someone who already understands how these firms are structured, how decisions get made and how change actually lands across member firms.

● Experience building tailored transformation roadmaps and adoption plans and steering them to measurable outcomes.
● A track record of driving adoption, retention and satisfaction with enterprise clients and senior stakeholders.
● Experience leading through influence rather than direct authority. You will set the direction that colleagues in other regions deliver against, so you need to be able to bring people with you.
● Experience working with legal, compliance or other regulated and complex industries or the ability to learn a complex domain exceptionally fast.
● Strong programme and project management skills; you keep multi-workstream initiatives moving and your clients confident.
● Excellent communication skills — written, verbal and interpersonal. You can lead boardroom conversations with legal and professional services leaders and roll up your sleeves with hands-on teams.
● High EQ: you know when to listen, when to advise and when to act.
● A love of fast-paced, early-stage environments where you help build the playbook, not just follow it.
● Fluency with metrics and driven by data, customer health and outcomes over process.
● Willingness to travel internationally around 25% of the time.

  • Carry out technical accounting assessments for new transactions, products, significant contracts and other business initiatives, and draft clear accounting papers and memos.

  • Support the development, implementation and upkeep of accounting policies and the accounting manual and give practical guidance on how policies should be applied across the business. 

  • Help put new accounting treatments into practice: make sure finance systems and processes are set up to support new activities, embed them into business-as-usual (BAU) processes and hand them over to the BAU teams.

  • Keep up to date with developments in financial and corporate reporting.

  • Solid working knowledge of IFRS and how it applies to financial services products and transactions. 

  • Clear written communication, with experience of drafting technical accounting papers or memos and explaining complex accounting to non-accountants. 

  • A questioning mindset, and the ability to drive change to systems and processes to improve efficiency. 

  • A team player and problem solver. You’ll show great initiative to listen, analyse, research, investigate and provide solutions to problems relating to financial accounting and reporting. 

  • Comfortable managing several pieces of work at once in a fast-moving environment, and building trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels. 

  • Curious about AI and how you can use it in your everyday work. 

  • Motivated, energetic and passionate about excellence and innovation.

  • Technical knowledge of IFRS 9 (expected credit losses, EIR), hedge accounting (IFRS 9 and IAS 39), IFRS 2 (share-based payments), and IAS 38 (intangible assets).

About the role

As Financial Controller at Happl, you’ll own the financial engine of the business — everything from the cash in the bank to the numbers our board and investors use to make decisions runs through you. You’ll run the monthly close, the full revenue cycle, the compliance calendar across two jurisdictions, and our treasury position, and you’ll decide how all of it gets built, systemised, and automated.

This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role with a direct line to leadership. You won’t be managing a process someone else designed — you’ll be deciding what good looks like across revenue, cash, compliance, and reporting, then making it happen. You’ll work closely with the CEO, the board, our investors, and our outsourced bookkeeping, audit, and tax partners, holding all of it to a standard that matches the product we’ve built.

We’re FCA-regulated and YCombinator-backed, having raised $11m to date, and we give global employers a single place to design, deliver, and manage benefits across 160+ countries and 70+ languages — which means the finance function behind the product has to be just as sharp as the product itself. We’re entering our next phase of growth, with an ambitious revenue trajectory and an expanding international footprint, and this role sits at the centre of it.

What you’ll be doing

  • Owning the monthly close on a fixed timetable — management accounts, balance sheet integrity, accruals, prepayments, and the revenue and cost reconciliations that sit behind them

  • Writing the commentary that explains what’s actually happened in the business, not just what the numbers say

  • Producing the monthly investor reporting pack and the financial sections of board materials — ARR and revenue analysis, cash and runway, burn efficiency, unit economics, cohort and retention metrics, and budget versus actual

  • Owning the full revenue cycle — invoicing, collections, aged debt, and revenue recognition across a multi-currency, multi-contract subscription base

  • Leading the rollout of automated billing and revenue recognition tooling, moving us from manual tracking to a system that scales without adding headcount

  • Managing our two legal entities — a US TopCo and a UK operating company — including statutory accounts, audit preparation, intercompany accounting, transfer pricing mechanics, and FX exposure between them

  • Owning the compliance calendar end to end across both jurisdictions — UK VAT returns, corporation tax, US federal and state filings, sales tax where applicable, and payroll taxes

  • Supporting our FCA regulatory reporting obligations and the financial controls that sit behind them

  • Running monthly payroll across jurisdictions, pension and benefits administration, employee expenses, and the finance side of onboarding and offboarding

  • Owning the cash position and treasury strategy — cash flow forecasting, working capital, FX management, and structuring how we hold company funds to earn a sensible return without taking risk we shouldn’t

  • Managing our outsourced bookkeeping, accounting, and tax partners — holding them to deadlines and quality, and pulling work in-house where doing so makes us faster

  • Owning the finance tech stack and having a strong opinion on it, actively replacing manual work with automation and AI-assisted workflows across reconciliations, invoice processing, variance analysis, and reporting drafts

  • Leveraging AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT to speed up your own work and build the systems that let finance scale without adding headcount

  • Acting as the financial conscience of the business, with a direct line to the founders and a real say in how we grow

What we’re looking for

  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA), or qualified by experience with a track record that stands up to scrutiny

  • Genuine ownership of a monthly close cycle and management reporting pack, start to finish

  • Strong technical grounding in revenue recognition, accruals accounting, and balance sheet control

  • Comfortable with tax and compliance across VAT, corporation tax, and payroll, ideally spanning both the UK and US

  • AI-native in your approach — you already use AI tools in your day-to-day work and can talk specifically about what you’ve automated and what it saved you

  • Exceptional attention to detail, alongside the judgement to know when precision matters and when speed does

  • A clear communicator — you can explain a number to a non-finance audience without patronising them or losing them

  • Ideally, SaaS or subscription business experience, particularly ARR reporting and deferred revenue, and familiarity with modern billing infrastructure like Xero or Stripe

  • Comfort with SQL, Python, or low-code automation tools is a bonus, not a requirement, but it will make your life here significantly easier

What to expect

Being Financial Controller at Happl is not a maintenance role. You’ll be building the finance function as you run it — choosing the systems, designing the controls, and deciding how billing, revenue recognition, and reporting should work as we scale into new markets and currencies. That’s not a caveat; it’s the role.

Some weeks will be genuinely rewarding — a reporting pack you built gives the board real clarity, a manual process you automated saves the team hours every month, a treasury decision you made puts real value on the table. Some will be hard — closing the books on a fixed timetable, holding partners and advisors to a deadline, and making judgement calls across two jurisdictions with incomplete information.

What you get in return is real scope. You’ll own the whole picture — revenue, cash, compliance, treasury, and reporting — across two jurisdictions and 160+ countries of operations, with a direct line to the founders and reporting that goes straight to the board and our investors. This is the foundation of a finance function that will grow with the business, and the right person grows with it.

description:
ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :

École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.

Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.

IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.

Les activités du centre RAPSODEE sont structurées en deux groupes de recherche dans les domaines de l’énergie, de l’environnement et du génie particulaire avec un accent particulier sur des procédés durables : plus intenses, plus économes en énergie, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus sûrs.

Le poste est ouvert dans le fond propre d’IMT Mines Albi. Une collaboration avec le laboratoire de chimie de coordination (LCC) à Toulouse est prévue.

 

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :

A ce jour, les carburants fossiles sont encore largement utilisés dans les différents secteurs industriels et notamment pour le secteur de transport, qui sont une source importante d’émission de gaz à effet de serre. Pour réduire l’impact environnemental du secteur de transport, les carburants de synthèse jouent un rôle important, en particulier pour le transport aérien de demain. Parmi les voies de R&D étudiées à ce jour pour la production de ces carburants de synthèse, le captage du CO2 et l’hydrogénation directe de ce CO2 par de l’hydrogène obtenu par l’électrolyse de l’eau avec de l’électricité renouvelable est une voie stratégique. L'un de leurs atouts majeurs réside dans l’optimisation de la production pour minimiser le coût du produit final, et la compatibilité des carburants de synthèse avec les infrastructures et les flottes existantes.

Ce projet, qui réunit deux laboratoires (RAPSODEE à Albi, et LCC à Toulouse), vise à produire des carburants alternatifs par hydrogénation directe du CO2 via une synthèse de Fischer-Tropsch à partir de CO2 (CO2-FTS). Ce processus se décompose en deux étapes successives : (i) l'hydrogénation du CO2 en CO (réaction inverse du gaz à l'eau, ou RWGS), suivie (ii) de l'hydrogénation du CO en hydrocarbures (synthèse de Fischer-Tropsch, ou FTS). Ce projet continue la recherche récente entre les deux laboratoires sur le même sujet, en développant des systèmes catalytiques multifonctionnels assurant la conversion, en une seule étape, dans un seul réacteur et à une seule condition de température et de pression, du CO2 et H2 en carburants liquides. Une attention particulière sera accordée à l’ingénierie de la composition, de la structure et de l’environnement des sites actifs, afin d’établir des relations structure-activité et de comprendre le rôle de chaque composant métallique dans les différentes étapes réactionnelles. Cette stratégie vise à dépasser les limitations des catalyseurs conventionnels en améliorant leur activité, sélectivité, stabilité et résistance à la désactivation. Le projet contribuera ainsi au développement d’une nouvelle génération de catalyseurs multifonctionnels pour la valorisation directe et durable du CO2 en carburants et produits chimiques à valeur ajoutée.

Les missions sont les suivantes :

  •        Etat de l’art : Une étude bibliographique est prévue sur les derniers travaux publiés sur ce sujet, pour compléter le travail réalisé en début de 2026.

  •        Synthèse et caractérisation des catalyseurs multifonctionnels : des catalyseurs bimétalliques et multifonctionnels à base de fer et/ou de cobalt pour la conversion directe du CO2 en hydrocarbures par voie Fischer-Tropsch seront développés. L’objectif sera d’obtenir des matériaux présentant une synergie contrôlée entre différentes fonctions catalytiques, permettant de favoriser simultanément l’activation/hydrogénation du CO2, la formation des intermédiaires carbonés et leur transformation sélective en chaînes hydrocarbonées. Les paramètres à étudier sont : la modification des supports catalytiques par des promoteurs efficaces ; le contrôle de la taille, la forme et la composition de la phase active, le contrôle de l’équilibre entre les fonctions pour l’activation du CO2 et de l’hydrogène. Ces matériaux seront caractérisés par différentes méthodes de caractérisation conventionnelles ou avancées.

  •        Evaluation des systèmes catalytiques en CO2-FTS : Les catalyseurs synthétisés seront évalués à l’échelle laboratoire. La performance des meilleurs catalyseurs pourra être évaluée à l’échelle pilote.

  •        Valorisation des résultats : Les résultats obtenus feront l’objet de la valorisation sous forme de brevet et ensuite communiqués dans les congrès et les journaux scientifiques.

 

CAPACITE ET ATTITUDES :

Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables :

Des compétences solides en catalyse hétérogène, en particulier pour la conversion du CO2 sont recherchées.

Capacités et aptitudes :

Des qualités de synthèse, d’organisation et de communication sont également nécessaires pour mener à bien les missions de ce poste.

PROFIL RECHERCHE :

Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat obtenu il y a moins de 3 ans.

AU-DELÀ DE L’ENVIRONNEMENT PROFESSIONNEL, POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? :

  • cadre de travail agréable dans un campus de 22 ha

  • 49 jours de congés par an

Vous aimez le terrain, les sites qui ne se ressemblent pas et le moment où le lien monte enfin. Chez Azurreo, vous installez, raccordez, testez et dépannez notre propre infrastructure réseaux et télécoms, celle qui fait tourner nos activités et nos plateformes à travers le monde.

Un poste de terrain, mais avec des horaires fixes du lundi au vendredi, des heures supplémentaires payées et inscrites au contrat, des frais avancés par l'entreprise, et vos habilitations financées si vous ne les avez pas encore.

Qui nous sommes

Azurreo est la branche télécommunications et technologies de Seelon Holdings, groupe d'investissement international présent sur quatre continents. Nous sommes un acteur de référence du test de performance des réseaux : notre plateforme SignalVerify mesure la qualité de service et la qualité d'expérience des réseaux dans plus de 144 pays.

Depuis plus de quinze ans, nous accompagnons opérateurs télécoms, intégrateurs, constructeurs et grandes entreprises dans le déploiement et la maintenance de leurs infrastructures en Europe, au Moyen-Orient et en Afrique : plus de 250 projets livrés dans plus de 25 pays.

Pour soutenir cette activité, Azurreo exploite et entretient son propre réseau d'infrastructures techniques en France et à l'international. C'est cette infrastructure que vous aurez en charge : celle qui permet à nos équipes et à nos plateformes de fonctionner, jour après jour, partout où nous sommes présents.

À quoi ressemble une semaine

Aucune semaine n'est identique :

  • Installation. Montage d'une baie sur l'un de nos sites, raccordement, brassage, étiquetage, tests, mise en service.

  • Dépannage. Une liaison qui ne monte pas depuis trois jours. Le plan de câblage ne correspond pas à l'existant. Vous cherchez, vous mesurez, vous trouvez, et vous écrivez ce que vous avez trouvé.

  • Datacenter. Rack & stack, cross-connects, mise en place d'équipements actifs.

  • Déploiement multi-sites. Plusieurs de nos sites dans la même semaine : bornes Wi-Fi, switches, configuration de base, comptes rendus.

  • Missions à l'international. Certaines semaines vous emmènent sur nos sites hors de France.

  • Journées base arrière. Préparation du matériel, gestion des stocks et de l'outillage, maintenance préventive, mise à jour des tickets. Toutes les semaines ne sont pas des semaines de route.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Installation et déploiement. Installation et mise en service d'équipements télécoms et informatiques sur nos sites. Câblage, raccordement et brassage. Déploiement de routeurs, switches, bornes Wi-Fi et équipements de connectivité. Préparation du matériel avant intervention, participation aux migrations et déploiements sur nos infrastructures.

  • Maintenance et support technique. Maintenance préventive et corrective de nos équipements. Diagnostic des incidents et mise en œuvre des dépannages. Remplacement et reconfiguration d'équipements défectueux. Vérification du bon fonctionnement après intervention.

  • Suivi et reporting. Rédaction des comptes rendus d'intervention, mise à jour des outils de suivi et des tickets d'incidents, gestion du matériel confié, participation aux stocks et inventaires, remontée des anomalies aux équipes concernées.

  • Qualité et sécurité. Respect des procédures qualité et sécurité d'Azurreo et des consignes propres à chaque site, usage approprié des équipements et outils mis à disposition.

Les technologies que vous rencontrerez

  • Réseaux : TCP/IP, VLAN, DHCP, DNS, VPN, LAN / WAN

  • Constructeurs : Cisco, Huawei, Aruba, Fortinet, Juniper

  • Télécoms : fibre optique, FTTH, FTTO, RJ45, brassage, baies informatiques

  • Datacenter : rack & stack, cross-connect, installation, maintenance

Vous ne maîtrisez pas tout cela ? Personne ne le maîtrise entièrement. Nous cherchons de bonnes bases techniques, de la curiosité et de la rigueur. Le reste s'apprend.

Parlons des déplacements franchement

  • Les déplacements en France et à l'international font partie intégrante du poste : ce n'est pas occasionnel, c'est une exigence.

  • Le rythme varie réellement selon les projets : certaines semaines sans déplacement, d'autres avec des découchés en France ou à l'étranger. Nous ne garantissons pas de rythme fixe.

  • Le véhicule utilitaire est mis à disposition pour les interventions en France : ce n'est pas un véhicule de fonction et il ne rentre pas chez vous le soir.

  • Les imprévus font partie du métier : matériel non livré, local fermé, câblage existant non conforme au plan.

  • Il y a de la manutention, des faux plafonds et des locaux techniques exigus.

  • En contrepartie : tous les frais professionnels sont pris en charge en amont, les horaires restent fixes, les heures supplémentaires sont payées, et vous ne passez pas vos journées au même bureau à faire la même chose.

Le profil que nous cherchons

Indispensable

  • Résider en France

  • Permis B en cours de validité

  • Disponible pour des déplacements fréquents, en France et à l'international

  • Formation ou expérience dans les télécommunications, les réseaux ou les infrastructures techniques

  • Connaissances en réseaux informatiques, câblage RJ45 et fibre optique

  • Capacité à diagnostiquer et résoudre des incidents techniques

  • Français courant, anglais niveau A2 minimum (à l'oral et pour lire de la documentation technique)

  • Maîtrise des outils bureautiques courants

  • Autonomie, rigueur, organisation

  • Capacité à travailler en mobilité et à vous adapter à des environnements techniques variés

Apprécié, mais pas exigé

  • Anglais au-delà du niveau A2

  • Expérience sur équipements Cisco, Huawei, Aruba, Fortinet ou Juniper

  • Fibre optique : raccordement, soudure, mesures. Wi-Fi, datacenter

  • Certifications réseau (CCNA ou équivalent) et habilitations à jour : AIPR, habilitation électrique, travail en hauteur, CACES nacelle, SST. Si vous ne les avez pas, nous organisons la formation pour que vous les obteniez.

Formation : Bac Pro SN, BTS SIO, BTS CIEL, BTS Télécommunications, BUT/DUT Réseaux & Télécommunications, Licence professionnelle Réseaux, ou expérience équivalente. Ce que vous avez fait compte autant que ce que vous avez étudié.

Ce que nous vous offrons

  • Des horaires fixes du lundi au vendredi et pas d'astreinte

  • Des heures supplémentaires payées, majorées et inscrites au contrat

  • Des frais avancés par l'entreprise

  • Vos certifications et habilitations financées si vous ne les avez pas

  • Une formation continue réelle, avec accès direct aux ingénieurs de l'entreprise

  • Des missions variées, en France et à l'international, sur notre propre infrastructure

Le processus de recrutement

  • Étude de votre candidature par notre équipe recrutement

  • Entretien RH, en visio (30 à 40 min), avec le recrutement, sur votre parcours, vos attentes et le poste en détail

  • Entretien technique (45 à 60 min) avec votre futur manager, sur la technique, le terrain et votre méthode

  • Entretien final (30 min) avec Adam Anbari, gérant d'Azurreo EURL

L'embauche est conditionnée à une visite médicale d'aptitude au poste.

Comment candidater

Envoyez-nous votre CV. Pas besoin de lettre de motivation ; quelques lignes sur une intervention dont vous êtes fier (ce qu'il y avait à faire, ce qui a coincé, comment vous l'avez réglé) nous parlent davantage.

Azurreo étudie toutes les candidatures à compétences égales, sans distinction d'origine, de sexe, d'âge, de situation personnelle ou de handicap.
